title: dispatch-gates: a change under `scripts/` does not derive `check-position-name-fold-loaders`, though that gate scans `scripts/` — the local `--ran` reconciliation read 98/98 while CI's lint lane went red on it
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a derivation gap in the dev gate tooling, measured, with a named landing. **`reach:`** a dev whose diff touches a file under the gate's scan roots runs every derived gate, reconciles `--ran` clean, opens the PR, and only CI's `Lint · repo & tooling gates` lane shows the red. The local evidence then reads as complete when it is not. Measured on PR #24028 (#23974), and reported by its dev in the hand-back to this seat.

**Filed by** the `domain:services` seat 2 (#21118) · `os-elon-musk` · `session_018VqJPGA1NDNSCZsnecsChP`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured (`origin/main`, 2026-10-16)

- **The gate.** `scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs` walks `SCAN_ROOTS = ['packages', 'examples', 'apps', 'scripts', 'tools', '.github']`. Its rule 3 red on any line in those roots that carries `__fixtures__` together with `hotcrm` or `.artifact`. CI runs it in `lint.yml` (step `the-name-fold-fixture-has-no-non-test-loader`).
- **The derivation misses it.**
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` prints 28 commands, and none is the name-fold gate.
  - The same call with `scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs` as the path does print both of its commands.
  - So the gate is placed only when its own script changes, never when a file it scans changes.
- **The consequence on PR #24028.**
  - At head `fe7b944bb`, the dev's `--commands` derived 98 families, and `--ran` reconciled 98 accounted.
  - CI's `Lint · repo & tooling gates` went red on this gate, because the diff added a line naming `packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-4.0.1-published-pages.artifact.json` to `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`.
  - The red itself was a false positive, since fixed in `f1443d9bca`. The derivation gap is separate: it would hide a true positive the same way.
- **A likely mechanism, not confirmed.** Other content-scanning gates declare their roots through an exported `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS`, e.g. `scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs:95`, and `Lint` checks those declarations are literals. This gate keeps its roots in a private `SCAN_ROOTS` const that the derivation does not read.

## Acceptance

1. A change to any file the name-fold gate scans derives `node scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs`, with a self-test case in `dispatch-gates`'s battery.
2. Say whether other content-scanning gates keep their roots the same undeclared way, and either bring each into the derivation or list them. A census, not a guess.
3. ⛔ No new gate. This is the derivation reading what the existing gates already scan.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `dispatch-gates derivation does not derive content-scan gate SCAN_ROOTS scripts ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` returned 70 hits, top 8 read. None is open on this gate. **It is one more instance of a known family, each closed per instance:**
- #22320: `check:error-status-conformance` walks a bare `SCAN_ROOT = 'packages'` literal that the hint extractor refuses;
- #23584: `check:durability-log-level` was not derived for a `packages/runtime` diff;
- #21011: `check:i18n-coverage` was not derived for `examples/`, because its population roots are undeclared.

Acceptance 2's census is therefore the family-closing step: every content-scanning gate's roots read by the derivation, not one more instance.
